Measure.Description: Exact joint probability that any hazard occurs

Measure.Description: Sum of the marginals - an upper bound kept for comparison

Measure.Description: P(harm_to_humans = fatality) - individual risk of Kristensen et al. eq. (4) - not monetised

Measure.Description: How exposure accumulates - rate (per period T) or change

Measure.Name: ExposurePeriod
Measure.Description: Reference period T of the network probabilities (rate basis)

Measure.Name: ExposureDt
